HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 1
Data room index for the Series Seed, May 3, 2011
1. Corporate records: certificate of incorporation, bylaws, organizational consent,
good standing certificate from Delaware.
2. Founders: stock agreement, Section 83(b) elections for both founders.
3. Capitalization: cap table, stock ledger, equity plan.
4. Financings: note purchase agreement and notes, term sheet, Form D.
5. Intellectual property: technology assignment from Jane Doe, technology assignment
from Richard Roe, invention assignments, trademark application.
6. People: offer letters, advisor agreement.
7. Customers and vendors: customer terms, customer list, hosting agreement, privacy
policy.
8. Finance and tax: financial model, financial statements, employer identification
number.
9. Insurance: general liability and cyber binder, directors and officers binder.
10. Disputes and regulators: none to report.
